about: Issues no machine counts yet, each found by hand (the 2026-11-06 census, its 50 decisions, the 2026-11-07 database inventory). census.py counts them under 'I. Found by hand'. An item leaves only when it is fixed, when a count in census.py covers it, or when the operator decides it is not a defect (recorded in the commit that removes it).

items.category: a hand-written parser where a standard one exists
items.item: tools/shell_parse.py (1,035 lines) lexes bash and PowerShell by hand; standard parsers exist: bashlex for bash, PowerShell's own System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser

every panel's served keys were checked against the derived register by hand on 2026-11-18 (12 rows added; the flip's confidence and its spans deleted 2026-11-19); no machine check holds it: census.py checks only functions named compute_, bs_ or pick_, so a new served key with no row is not caught

tests' expected values checked against a source (2026-11-18): the prior day against Schwab's official close; the level strikes, charm walls and CRWD's flip worked out from the raw captured chain (#1172, #1174, tests/real_chains.py); the format tests pin a fixture's value only. Left: the tests built on hand-typed Level One and book messages (STAND-INS, the operator's decision)
/api/health over 1 s in 1 of 60 live requests (2026-11-18 14:37 CT, after #1169; 7 of 60 before): what is left holding the GIL is the pricing thread, 90% busy (the chain-lag decision)
/chains still sends a streamed contract's open interest, volume and quote fields, which the stream already pushes (STREAM-ONE, rule 3)

every watchlist ticker's screen values against Schwab's own numbers: the watchlist's prices and changes matched Schwab's exactly (2026-11-18 13:34 CT, all 9); the chain ladder's Schwab fields lag (next item); the levels and Greeks of every ticker against Schwab still to check

live update speed: the chain ladder showed SPY's 730 call a median 4.4 s (max 8.8 s) behind Schwab, 23 changes measured 2026-11-18 13:55 CT, marked LIVE; its fields are Schwab's own but served from the last reprice, and a full SPY reprice takes 1.4-2.7 s on a pricing thread 90% busy. The fix (serve them from the stream as received) is the operator's decision
